n: Arm EducateAI Coalition and Arm Introduction to AI course
t: A teacher training coalition and a free online Introduction to AI course from Arm.
steps: Find the Introduction to AI course from Arm on edX or Coursera.
Create a learner account on the platform you choose.
Plan about one week to finish it.
Note the lessons that fit your classroom.
Watch for coalition training news. The details are not yet published in the sources read.
